nurse.text: Fàilte to the Inverness Sanctuary. That's 'welcome', so you've learned something. Pop your team on the counter and have a seat, there's a kettle on.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Och, they've had a day. Sit down, take a tablet, and watch the kettle. It's a very slow kettle. It's very good.
All done. Mòran taing, that's 'many thanks'. Wrap up warm out there, it's wetter than it looks. Even when it looks wet.
The Ark terminal. It's powered by tea and a hamster wheel that nobody has volunteered to explain.

else.text: Dè a tha thu ag iarraidh? That's 'what do you want?'. Take your time. We're not going anywhere. It's raining.
